primary.usage: Body text, generic labels, buttons, subtitles

display.usage: Oversized hero headings (32-44sp), numeric cosmic counters, emphasis headers

accent.usage: Deity names, sacred chants, Chandra Dasa text, spiritual quotes

home_bento_grid.description: 7-row bento grid with specific card allocations and 12-16dp gaps.

content: Giant Tree Hero Card (~55% viewport height) - 3D banyan + deity stone shrine inside
Manifest Action Card (80dp height, spark animations)

deity_selection.description: Staggered rows of hexagonal tiles mapping to the 7 deities. Tiles feature carved stone textures.

animated_background.mesh_blobs: 3 slow-drifting blobs at 5% opacity in accent colors

premium_state.style: Locked features are grayed out (#2E2A3B text) with a prominent 🔒 icon.

motion.physics: Spring physics everywhere (use react-native-reanimated with spring configs).
motion.tree_aura: 3-layer breathing animation (pulsing scale/opacity) mapping to active Deity color.
motion.counters: Animated rolling/counting numbers for Cosmic Value.
motion.ritual_interaction: Hold-to-manifest logic on the hero tree. Explodes into a glowing seed and reforms back into a tree upon completion.

instructions_to_main_agent.1_Setup: Use Expo React Native. Load custom fonts (Satoshi, Cabinet Grotesk, Instrument Serif) via expo-font. Setup react-native-reanimated for all spring animations.
instructions_to_main_agent.2_Styles: Strictly map UI to the provided color hex codes. Surfaces must strictly avoid borders as per specs (`border: none` on surface cards).
instructions_to_main_agent.3_Hero_Section: The hero card needs to use absolute positioning or a stacked Image view for the 3D banyan tree over the background. Use the glowing deity aura dynamically mapped to the current selected deity color.
instructions_to_main_agent.4_Grid_Layout: Implement the home grid using standard Flexbox or specialized grid components. Mobile grids are essentially Flex layouts with wrapping and set percentage widths.
instructions_to_main_agent.5_Bottom_Sheet: Integrate `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` for the Manifestation setup flow, moving sequentially through steps.
instructions_to_main_agent.6_Background: Use absolute positioned `<Image>` components with low opacity for film grain, and looping SVG/Reanimated Views for the 3 mesh gradient blobs. Avoid particle libraries.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize spring animations over linear easing to achieve natural fluid interactions.
Always apply 'data-testid' or 'testID' attributes to interactive components like buttons, input fields, and bottom sheet triggers for robust automated testing.
For shadows, rely on elevation properties mapping to the Surface background colors rather than stark black shadows.
Never use generic AI fallback icons; strictly use styled iconography matching the mystic/petroglyph aesthetic.
Do not center-align body text or layout elements indiscriminately. Respect the Bento layout structure and keep dense information left-aligned.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays that sit on top of content. Apply glass-morphism/blur with a semi-opaque background color.
